title: Irish Snap Pea Salad
description: A refreshing salad perfect for spring, combining the crunch of snap peas and the sweetness of Irish peas with a crispy topping.
instructions: 1. Bring a pot of water to a boil and blanch the snap peas for 3-5 minutes.
2. Shock the snap peas in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
3. In a large bowl, combine the cooled snap peas, Irish peas, and crispy bacon (if using).
4. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon vinaigrette.
5. Pour the dressing over the pea mixture and toss to combine.
